title: Specification
body:
A Specification details the requirements for determining whether a network unduly burdens its beneficiaries (members or employees) with regard to access to care from in-network providers by ensuring beneficiaries have access to sufficient numbers of providers based on their specialties, travel time, and distance. Specifications are part of the criteria when performing an Accessibility or Adequacy analysis. Thus, depending on your selected criteria and whether your project is enabled for both Accessibility and Adequacy, you may use the same specification in either module. CMS Medicare Advantage Specifications are available within the Adequacy and Accessibility modules for the most recent years when you use the Standard CMS Medicare Advantage specialty mapping. These are found in the subcategory Global Specifications and are not editable.

Adding a New Specification

 A new specification can be added from four different places within Network360. * Go to **My Things** on the left side bar navigation menu: * Select **My Specifications** * Click on the **+Add New** link * Go to **Compliance** on the left side bar navigation menu: * Select **Specifications** * Click on the **+Add New Specification** button. * Within the **Accessibility** module: * Click on the **+Add New Analysis** button * Click on the **+Add New Specification** link * Within the **Adequacy** module: * Click on the **+Add New Analysis** button * Click on the **+Add Adequacy Specification** button. On the **Create New Specification** page: 1. Enter a unique **Name** for your specification. 2. To share with other users, click the **Share with everyone in your organization** checkbox. 3.
